comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Three hats which also give Gunfire boosts:

Sheriff's Hat
Western Hat
Pirate's Bicorne

Each hat gives +2 to Gunfire. The white Sheriff and red Western hats were available in past Sailor Bottles, while the purple Pirate's Bicorne is a rare drop from the Ganador William Kidd (orange version; 17th Century, phase 4 title required to challenge). Check their respective pages for further info.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Yes, the following outfits also give Gunfire bonuses:

Sheriff's Jacket (male-only)
Female Sheriff's Jacket (female-only)

The precise boosts are +2 Gunfire, +3 Sniping, +2 Trap. Both outfits were dropped by bottles in the past, as well.
